spans.s:
When a set of several words ending with case-affixes stands in a relation expressable by 'and' the set is made into a compound and the compound so formed is called द्वन्द्व।

Terms: समास-बहुव्रीही-विभक्ति-wo

The affix ट comes after the verb चर् 'to go' when a case-inflected word in composition with it denotes a location.

Terms: ट

The affix णमुल् comes after the verb पुर् 'to fill' when the word चर्मन् and उदर् are compounded with it.

Terms: णमुल्

After the name of a Vedic School, the affixes which denote the rule of that school, also come in the sense of 'collection thereof'.

Terms: तस्य समूहः

After a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction comes the affix ठक् in the sense of 'he goes on by means thereof'.

Terms: ठक्

The affix अञ् (+/- अ) comes, in the sense of a primitive serviceable for a product after a word expressing the product of leather.

Terms:

स is substituted for समान् before ब्रह्मचारिन् when it denotes persons engaged in fulfilling a common vow of studying the Vedas.

Terms: स Substitute

The augment नुक् (न्) comes after the reduplicates of चर् and फल् in the Intensive (with expressed or elided यङ्).

Terms: Reduplicate
